_README: These are COPY-PASTE EXAMPLES. Nothing here is active. Copy ONE entry into mcp.json (inside "mcpServers"). Details: docs/MCP.md

playwright._what: A browser the agent can drive. Runs on YOUR computer (needs Node.js). It offers 60+ tools, so you MUST choose a few with include.

github._what: GitHub's own MCP server, reached over the internet. Needs a TOKEN in .env as GITHUB_TOKEN (use a read-only token).

my-own-server._what: Your own MCP server, a Python file you wrote (see docs/MCP.md for a 15-line one).

some-remote-server._what: Any remote MCP server that gives you a URL and (optionally) a key.
